name: useChargingIntelligence
summary: Deep battery health, cycle count, manufacturing dates, and charging wattage tiers.
plain: Surfaces low-level battery health indicators: lifetime physical charge cycles, maximum state of health (SoH) capacity relative to design, manufacture and first-activation dates, and USB-PD PPS fast charging tiers.
description: Reads Android 14+ battery health metrics and Google Pixel power supply sysfs telemetry. Provides lifetime charge cycles (BatteryManager.EXTRA_CYCLE_COUNT), state of health percentage (/sys/class/power_supply/battery/soh), manufacture date, first-use date, charging wattage (BATTERY_PROPERTY_CURRENT_NOW times the battery voltage, only while the current is positive), and a tier classified from that wattage (slow, standard, rapid, ultra_rapid at 30 W and above). Values the app cannot read are null.

returns.name: stateOfHealthPercent
returns.desc: Current maximum battery capacity relative to factory design capacity (0-100%), or null if unreadable.

returns.name: cycleCount
returns.desc: Lifetime physical charge cycles completed by the battery pack.

returns.name: manufactureDate
returns.desc: Factory manufacture timestamp/date of the physical battery cell.

returns.name: firstUsageDate
returns.desc: Date the battery was first activated/used in service.

returns.name: chargingWattage
returns.desc: Real-time charging power in watts (W) delivered to the battery.

returns.name: chargingTier
returns.desc: Classification of chargingWattage (under 5 W slow, 5 W up to 18 W standard, 18 W up to 30 W rapid, 30 W and above ultra_rapid). Null when no wattage was read.

returns.name: chargeLimitAvailable
returns.desc: Whether the charge_limit_available sysfs node reads "1"; null when it cannot be read. The node says the limit is offered, not that it is switched on.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if battery telemetry query failed.

returns.name: refresh
returns.desc: Re-reads battery health and charging state.

actions.name: refresh()
actions.desc: Requests an updated battery intelligence reading.

agentNote: Battery cycle counts require Android 14+ (API 34+). State of health % and manufacture dates are read from Pixel battery sysfs nodes and are null where the app cannot read them; chargingTier is null when no wattage was read, so never show a default tier. chargeLimitAvailable says the charge limit is offered, not that it is on.
